shared_elements: low relief carving of human figures in profile
standing human figure with arm extended forward
procession/register composition with figures moving in one direction
horizontal border bands framing the scene
justification: Both are low-relief friezes with profile human figures arranged along a horizontal register bounded by patterned/decorated bands, and in each a standing figure extends an arm forward while leading or presenting. However, A shows a bridled two-humped pack animal being led by an attendant against a plain ground with rosette borders, whereas B shows an offering scene before a laden table under a rayed disc surrounded by dense inscriptional signs, with no animal and quite different figure proportions and attributes.
